iocNotes: Current NOC identifiers are search aliases. GBR resolves the four FIFA home associations. Associations without a separate IOC-recognized NOC have no IOC code here. LIB and SIN remain legacy search aliases for Lebanon and Singapore.
nameLocalizations: Node.js Intl.DisplayNames (CLDR), with football-association names and search aliases curated by Matchday XI.
